name: Harden-Runner
description: Harden-Runner provides runtime security for GitHub-hosted and self-hosted runners

allowed-endpoints.description: Only these endpoints will be allowed if egress-policy is set to block

denied-endpoints.description: These endpoints will be denied when endpoint blocking is enabled

egress-policy.description: Policy for outbound traffic, can be either audit or block

token.description: Used to avoid github rate limiting

disable-telemetry.description: Disable sending telemetry to StepSecurity API, can be set to true or false. This can only be set to true when egress-policy is set to block

disable-sudo.description: Disable sudo access for the runner account. Note: This parameter will be deprecated in the future. Please use disable-sudo-and-containers instead.

disable-sudo-and-containers.description: Disable sudo and container access for the runner account

policy.description: Policy name to be used from the policy store. Requires id-token: write permission.

api-key.description: StepSecurity API key for authenticating with the policy store. Required when use-policy-store is set to true.

use-policy-store.description: Set to true to fetch policy from the policy store using the API key. This is the preferred method over the policy input which requires id-token: write permissio

deploy-on-self-hosted-vm.description: Set to true to deploy the Harden Runner agent directly on a self-hosted runner VM (Linux only). The recommended approach for self-hosted VMs is to bake the agen

customer.description: StepSecurity customer name. Required in GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) environments for TLS checks, policy fetching, and direct self-hosted VM agent installati

server-name.description: GHES server name registered with StepSecurity. Required in GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) environments for TLS checks, policy fetching, and direct self-hosted
